decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting is a specialist line with a long certification and procurement investment behind it, so management will persist through any slow early uptake.
The spring-balanced desk lamp line has its own page and fits the ergonomic workplace positioning, so modest early results are read as a normal ramp-up.
The newly announced G2 generation of a core interior luminaire was publicly launched and is central to the LED portfolio, which makes dropping it hard to justify.
Presented as a flagship of the firm's direction, the microprismatic pendant carries high public commitment, so any weak results would be attributed to temporary market conditions.

HMI technology runs against the firm's announced LED direction, making this the most exposed marine line, but sunk development and certification costs and loyal maritime customers favor keeping it for now.
Marine searchlights are part of the robust specialist niche the firm has invested in, so management keeps the line within its broader marine offering.
